# Third-party programs the tests run at their real addresses, as deployed on
# Solana mainnet. Their binaries are never committed: `task
# contracts:solana:fixtures` dumps each from mainnet into .shonin/fixtures/
# and checks it against the hash here, and the tests check it again before
# loading it. A hash that no longer matches means the program was upgraded on
# mainnet: run the tests against the new binary before taking its hash.
